answer: Sybil resistance here rests on staking plus proof-of-personhood: each agent must lock a bond and pass a unique identity attestation before participating. Duplicate or hollow identities are detected and slashed, so an attacker forging N sybils must fund N bonds and N verifications, burning real capital per fake node. Reputation accrues only to verified keys, making each new identity a costly ember that fades without genuine history, while honest agents compose a sonnet of trust over time.
